The '''Dearic Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Omkoo]] recruited a spacer at the starport to investigate vandalism at an old [[Aqualish gravesite]].<ref name="SWG:GR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Grave Robbers|Talus}}</ref>
